verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a CLI (`pd deploy`, `pd dev`) for deploying and live-developing custom event-source components from local code. It also publishes source-available triggers and actions you can extend or contribute via GitHub PR, and ships TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs plus a REST API for building integrations, so a developer can build custom or private connectors on a documented platform. missing for 10: a documented component-authoring API reference (props, auth definitions for a new app), explicit evidence of private or unpublished custom app and OAuth registration, and independent hands-on corroboration of building a custom component.
